faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out and we'll be happy to help.

items.q: Can I start using it right after signing up?
items.a: Once your payment is confirmed, our platform team reviews and approves your account (in some periods this step may be automatic). Your dashboard opens once approved.

items.q: Can I try it without paying?
items.a: Yes, we offer a 14-day trial with no card required — your trial starts on the plan you select during sign-up.

items.q: What happens if my registration is rejected?
items.a: Your account stays inactive and you are never charged. Reach out to us if you have questions.

items.q: If I change plans, do I lose data or enabled modules?
items.a: No. Even on a downgrade, your existing modules don't shut off immediately — they stay on until our team reviews and decides.

items.q: Can I use a module that isn't in my plan?
items.a: Yes — request it from your dashboard with one click; once approved, it's activated instantly.

items.q: Do the displayed prices include tax?
items.a: Applicable taxes are added on top of the displayed prices.
You run the application on your own servers (via Docker) instead of ours, verified with your license key.

items.q: Should I choose self-hosted or cloud?
items.a: If you want to get started fast with automatic updates, choose cloud (SaaS); if you need to keep your data on your own infrastructure, self-hosted fits better — reach out and we'll help you decide.

items.q: Could my data mix with another business's data?
items.a: No. Every business is fully isolated at the database level (row-level security) — this isolation is verified with automated tests for every new feature.

items.q: Are you compliant with data protection regulations?
items.a: Yes — our privacy notice, cookie policy, and data deletion flow are live; see the legal links at the bottom of the page for details.
It's optional by default; if it becomes mandatory platform-wide, that will be announced separately.

legal.draftNotice: This page is draft text — the final legal wording will be published at launch.

kvkk.title: Privacy Notice
kvkk.p1: As RKYS Dashboard, we act as the data controller when processing your personal data under applicable data protection law.
kvkk.p2: The name, email and business information you provide when creating an account are processed to deliver the service, for billing, and to handle your support requests.
kvkk.p3: Your data is retained only for as long as necessary to provide the service and is not shared with third parties except where legally required.
kvkk.p4: To exercise your data protection rights, you can contact us at support@rkys.app.

cerez.title: Cookie Policy
cerez.p1: This site uses essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your preferences.
cerez.p2: Beyond essential cookies, optional analytics cookies may be used for usage statistics.
cerez.p3: You can delete or block cookies at any time from your browser settings; this may cause some features to stop working.

sozlesme.title: Terms of Use
sozlesme.p1: This agreement governs the relationship between businesses ("tenants") using the RKYS Dashboard service and the platform.
sozlesme.p2: The service is provided "as is"; after the 14-day trial period, you must subscribe to a plan to continue using it.
sozlesme.p3: The tenant is solely responsible for the accuracy and legal compliance of the data belonging to its own customers and staff.
sozlesme.p4: The platform reserves the right to suspend an account in case of misuse or payment delay.

veriSilme.title: Data Deletion Request
veriSilme.p1: You have the right to request the permanent deletion of your account and all data belonging to your business.
veriSilme.p2: A deletion request is irreversible; once received, our team will delete your data, subject to legally required retention periods.
veriSilme.cta: To delete your account, go to Settings → Delete My Account in your admin panel.
